ExampleDesign.Name: versal_cpm6_soc_platform
ExampleDesign.Description:
Reference SoC platform for embedded RPU bare-metal firmware managing CPM6-based PCIe designs. Provides a reusable baseline (NoC, DDRMC, RPUs, TCM, debug UART, Tandem-appropriate boot flash) with CPM6 configurable per-controller as Endpoint or Root Port, so downstream teams do not need to rebuild this foundation for every CPM6-based design.
Current version implements CTRL0 and CTRL1, each independently selectable as Disabled, PCIe Root Port, or Endpoint (Gen6 x8, Bridge mode), with DDR optional for any combination, including both controllers active simultaneously and independent of each other (no cross-wiring between them) in any Root Port / Endpoint combination. Link speed and link width are also independently selectable per controller.
